We recently went on a Ladakh trip with Nomadic Steps, and it turned out to be one of the most beautiful and memorable experiences for me and my wife.

From start to finish, everything was well-organized — stay, transport, food, and sightseeing. A special thanks to Mr. Nurboo, who made sure we were comfortable throughout the journey. He genuinely took care of our needs and preferences, especially in terms of food and accommodation, and ensured that we got the best at every place we visited.

He is not just a tour operator but a humble and trustworthy local person who understands the region very well. We never had to worry about anything. Because of his local knowledge and planning, we could enjoy Ladakh's beauty stress-free.

Highly recommend Nomadic Steps and Mr. Nurboo for anyone planning a trip to Ladakh. Truly a 5-star experience!

Ladakh hits different when your journey is this smooth 🏔️
Thanks to Nomadic Steps, especially Sahil & skarma bhiya , for turning this adventure into an unforgettable experience 🖤

I recently had the chance to visit Leh Ladakh, and my trip was nicely managed by Norbu from Nomadic Steps & team ( Sonam, Sahil & Rohit). From the moment we arrived, everything ran smoothly — transport, itineraries, and local guidance were well taken care of. The stays were decent: clean, basic, and comfortable enough after long days of adventure.

But the real star of the show was Ladakh itself. The landscapes are simply breathtaking — snow-capped peaks, turquoise lakes, winding valleys, and skies so clear they feel unreal. The quiet monasteries, friendly locals, and the raw, untouched beauty of the region make it unlike anywhere else I’ve been. Every corner seemed like it belonged on a postcard.
Value for money! A huge shoutout to our marshal, Sahil—an absolute expert and true professional who made the trip safe, fun, and unforgettable.
